zhCN: 罗德岛的博士从石棺中醒来时，几乎失去了全部记忆，却依然保留着洞悉战局的头脑。博士很少亲自挥剑，而是以简短的战术指令调度同伴；当战局逼入绝境时，博士会放任体内“巴别塔的恶灵”短暂苏醒，将全部{g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}智力{/g}化为最锋利的战斗本能。
enGB: Awakening from the sarcophagus with nearly all memories lost, the Doctor of Rhodes Island nevertheless retains a mind that reads the battlefield like an open book. Rarely raising a blade in person, the Doctor directs allies with brief tactical orders—and when the battle demands it, lets the Specter of Babel awaken within, turning {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} into the sharpest fighting instinct.

zhCN: 在1级时，博士获得战术指令法术书，可施展至多9环的奥术指令。博士以{g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}智力{/g}作为施法关键属性，无需提前准备即可自发施展已知指令；其每日法术位与已知法术数量与同等级的术士相同，且施展战术指令不受护甲或盾牌的奥术施法失败率影响。0环指令为戏法，可无限次施展。
enGB: At 1st level, the Doctor gains the Tactical Orders spellbook and can cast arcane orders of up to 9th level. The Doctor casts known orders spontaneously using {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} as their casting ability score, following the sorcerer's spells-per-day and spells-known progression, and ignores arcane spell failure chance from armor and shields. 0-level orders are cantrips and can be cast at will.

zhCN:
你以{g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}迅捷动作{/g}标记视野内的一名敌人。在标记持续期间，所有友军对该目标进行的{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}与伤害掷骰获得 +1 洞察{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}；圣武士等级每达到 4 级，该{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}再提高 +1（最高在 20 级时达到 +6）。
标记持续的{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}数等于你的{g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}智力{/g}调整值（至少 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}）。同一时间只能维持一个集火标记；对新目标下达集火会立即移除先前的标记。每日可使用次数等于 3 + 你的{g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}智力{/g}调整值。
enGB:
As a {g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}swift action{/g}, you mark one enemy within sight. While the mark lasts, all allies gain a +1 insight {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} rolls against that target, plus an additional +1 for every 4 paladin levels you possess (to a maximum of +6 at 20th level).
The mark lasts for a number of {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}rounds{/g} equal to your {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} modifier (minimum 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}). You can maintain only one mark at a time; marking a new target removes any previous mark. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} modifier.

zhCN: 所有友军对该目标进行的{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}与伤害掷骰获得洞察{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。
enGB: All allies gain an insight {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} rolls against this target.

zhCN: 达到2级后，博士将自身的{g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}智力{/g}调整值（若为正数）作为不具类型{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}加到所有{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}上。在巴别塔的恶灵生效期间，该{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}减半；达到20级后，恶灵生效期间不再减半。
enGB: At 2nd level, the Doctor adds their {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} modifier (if positive) as a stacking untyped {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on all {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}saving throws{/g}. enGB: Allies within 10 feet gain the effects of Aura of Command.

enGB: At 4th level, the Doctor radiates a 10-foot Aura of Command. The Doctor and all allies within the aura gain a +1 competence {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}initiative{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Check}checks{/g}. This aura does not function while the Doctor is unconscious or while the Specter of Babel is active. This ability replaces the paladin's spellcasting.

zhCN: 在{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}先攻检定{/g}上获得 +2 表现{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。
enGB: You gain a +2 competence {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}initiative{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Check}checks{/g}.

zhCN: 30 尺内的友军获得全军指令。
enGB: Allies within 30 feet gain the effects of Total Command.

zhCN: 达到11级时，博士的指挥灵光范围扩大至 30 尺，且在{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}先攻检定{/g}上提供的表现{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}提高至 +2。此能力替换正义灵光。
enGB: At 11th level, the radius of the Doctor's Aura of Command increases to 30 feet, and the competence {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}initiative{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Check}checks{/g} increases to +2. This ability replaces aura of justice.

zhCN: 博士的圣疗每日使用次数以及对不死生物造成伤害时的豁免{g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g}改由{g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}智力{/g}调整值决定，其余效果与圣武士的圣疗相同。
enGB: The Doctor's daily uses of lay on hands and its saving throw {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} against undead are based on their {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} modifier instead of {g|Encyclopedia:Charisma}Charisma{/g}; otherwise, this ability functions as the standard paladin lay on hands.

zhCN: 博士引导正向能量的豁免{g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g}改由{g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}智力{/g}调整值决定，每次使用消耗 2 次圣疗次数；其余效果与圣武士的引导正向能量相同。
enGB: The saving throw {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} of the Doctor's channel positive energy is based on their {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} modifier instead of {g|Encyclopedia:Charisma}Charisma{/g}, and each use expends 2 uses of lay on hands; otherwise, this ability functions as the standard paladin channel positive energy.

zhCN: 巴别塔的恶灵生效期间，博士只能施展带有【恶灵】标记的战术指令；源石技艺精通暂时失效且法术穿透与指令豁免{g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g}承受等于转移量的{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}；指挥灵光与全军指令暂时失效。
enGB: While the Specter of Babel is active, the Doctor can only cast tactical orders with the [Specter] descriptor; Originium Arts Mastery is suppressed and spell penetration and spell save {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DCs{/g} take a {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} equal to the Transfer Value; Aura of Command and Total Command are suppressed.

zhCN: 在恶灵余波期间，博士每{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}只能执行一个{g|Encyclopedia:Move_Action}移动动作{/g}，无法进行任何攻击（包括{g|Encyclopedia:Attack_Of_Opportunity}借机攻击{/g}）、施展{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}，也无法主动使用职业能力或物品。
enGB: During the Specter's Aftermath, the Doctor can take only a single {g|Encyclopedia:Move_Action}move action{/g} each {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g} and cannot make {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attacks{/g} (including {g|Encyclopedia:Attack_Of_Opportunity}attacks of opportunity{/g}), cast {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g}, or actively use abilities or items.

zhCN: 在恶灵余波期间，博士的移动{g|Encyclopedia:Speed}速度{/g}获得 +50 尺不具类型{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}（可叠加）。
enGB: During the Specter's Aftermath, the Doctor gains a stacking +50-foot untyped {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to movement {g|Encyclopedia:Speed}speed{/g}.

zhCN: 巴别塔的恶灵：敏捷形态

博士的{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷{/g}获得等于转移量两倍的不具类型{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，所穿盔甲的最大{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}上限提高等于转移量的数值，且近战武器{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}与伤害掷骰改用{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷{/g}调整值代替{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力量{/g}调整值（取较高者）。
enGB: The Doctor gains an untyped {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dexterity{/g} equal to twice the Transfer Value, increases the maximum {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dexterity{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} of worn armor by the Transfer Value, and uses their {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dexterity{/g} modifier instead of {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}Strength{/g} on melee {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} rolls (whichever is higher).

zhCN: 巴别塔的恶灵：体质形态
博士的{g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}体质{/g}获得等于转移量两倍的不具类型{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，其最大{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}强韧豁免{/g}随之提高。
enGB: The Doctor gains an untyped {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g} equal to twice the Transfer Value, increasing maximum {g|Encyclopedia:HP}hit points{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Fortitude saves{/g} accordingly.

zhCN: 唤醒巴别塔的恶灵并进入敏捷形态。恶灵状态结束时，博士将陷入持续 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}的恶灵余波；你可以使用“结束恶灵”能力提前终止该状态。
enGB: Awaken the Specter of Babel in Agile Form. When the Specter ends, you enter the Specter's Aftermath for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}rounds{/g}; you can end the effect early using End the Specter.

zhCN: 唤醒巴别塔的恶灵并进入体质形态。恶灵状态结束时，博士将陷入持续 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}的恶灵余波；你可以使用“结束恶灵”能力提前终止该状态。
enGB: Awaken the Specter of Babel in Enduring Form. When the Specter ends, you enter the Specter's Aftermath for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}rounds{/g}; you can end the effect early using End the Specter.

zhCN: 选择敏捷形态或体质形态以唤醒巴别塔的恶灵。
enGB: Choose Agile Form or Enduring Form to awaken the Specter of Babel.

zhCN: 选择敏捷形态或体质形态以唤醒巴别塔的恶灵。
enGB: Choose Agile Form or Enduring Form to awaken the Specter of Babel.

zhCN: 选择敏捷形态或体质形态以唤醒巴别塔的恶灵。
enGB: Choose Agile Form or Enduring Form to awaken the Specter of Babel.

zhCN: 达到8级时，博士可以唤醒体内沉睡的另一个自己——巴别塔的恶灵。开启时需选择敏捷形态或体质形态（结束前不可切换），将一半的{g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}智力{/g}调整值作为“转移量”转化为纯粹的战斗本能。博士每日可维持恶灵状态的{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}数等于 4 + 圣武士等级 + {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}智力{/g}调整值。恶灵状态结束时，博士会陷入持续 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}的恶灵余波。此能力替换坚定灵光。
enGB: At 8th level, the Doctor can awaken the other self slumbering within—the Specter of Babel. Upon activating this ability, choose either Agile Form or Enduring Form (this choice cannot be changed until the effect ends), converting half of your {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} modifier into pure fighting instinct as the Transfer Value. You can maintain the Specter for a number of {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}rounds{/g} per day equal to 4 + your paladin level + your {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} modifier. When the Specter ends, you suffer the Specter's Aftermath for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}rounds{/g}. This ability replaces aura of resolve.

zhCN: 达到14级时，巴别塔的恶灵的转移量提高为博士的全部{g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}智力{/g}调整值。此外，敏捷形态额外获得反射闪避，体质形态额外获得{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g} 3/—（可与其他来源的伤害减免叠加）。此能力替换信仰灵光。
enGB: At 14th level, the Transfer Value of the Specter of Babel increases to the Doctor's full {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} modifier. In addition, Agile Form grants evasion, and Enduring Form grants {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}DR{/g} 3/— (which stacks with other sources of damage reduction). This ability replaces aura of faith.

zhCN: 达到17级时，博士可以{g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}迅捷动作{/g}开启巴别塔的恶灵，且在恶灵生效期间仍可使用集火。此能力替换正气灵光。
enGB: At 17th level, the Doctor can activate the Specter of Babel as a {g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}swift action{/g} and can use Focus Fire while the Specter is active. This ability replaces aura of righteousness.

zhCN: 以{g|Encyclopedia:Free_Action}自由动作{/g}立即结束巴别塔的恶灵，并进入持续 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}的恶灵余波。
enGB: As a {g|Encyclopedia:Free_Action}free action{/g}, end the Specter of Babel immediately and enter the Specter's Aftermath for 2 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}rounds{/g}.
